EDEP 2374.title: Educational Psychology for PK-12 Teachers
EDEP 2374.description: Theoretical, empirical, and practical foundations of educational psychology, including human learning, cognitive processes, development, motivation, classroom management, and instructional strategies for diverse students. Emphasis on application of theory to practice.

EDEP 2444.title: Motivating Yourself and Others
EDEP 2444.description: Survey of human motivation research and research methodologies in education, psychology, and neuroscience. Application of this research in diverse populations, including analysis of human motivation and design of motivating activities.

EDEP 3474.title: Principles and Practices in PK-12 Assessment
EDEP 3474.description: Theoretical, empirical, and practical foundations of assessment in PK-12. Basic test design and measurement principles and practices, the use of assessments in education, the use of assessment data, and critical issues in assessment. Emphasis on creating classroom-level assessment systems.

EDEP 5114.title: Learning and Cognition
EDEP 5114.description: Psychological theories and models which serve as a basis for educational models and practice. Emphasis on conceptions of learning and cognitive process. Pre: Graduate standing.

EDEP 5154.title: Psych Foundations for Teachers
EDEP 5154.description: Emphasizes applying human learning and developmental theories to classroom settings including school learning theories, child and adolescent cognitive development, instructional strategies, classroom management, student motivation, and learning assessment strategies. Graduate Standing Required. Admission in a graduate teacher education program or instructor permission required.

EDEP 5474.title: Educational Assessment of Students
EDEP 5474.description: Theoretical, empirical, and practical foundations of educational assessment. Test design and measurement principles and practices, the use of assessments in education, the use of assessment data, and critical issues in assessment. Emphasis on creating course-level assessment systems.

EDEP 5964.title: Field Studies in Education
EDEP 5964.description: Applied study in one or more educational institutions. Research, evaluation, curricular, and instructional projects are examples of appropriate projects of study. The student is graded on the basis of the design of the project and ability to carry it through and report the results.

EDEP 6104.title: Learning and Cognition
EDEP 6104.description: Psychological research and theories that serve as a basis for educational models and practice, including behaviorist views of learning, social cognitive theory, cognitive views of learning, developmental and contextual perspectives of learning, and complex learning and cognition. Emphasis on the associated teaching implications. Pre: Graduate standing

EDEP 6114.title: Cognitive Processes
EDEP 6114.description: Investigates complex human learning from the perspective of cognitive/information processing theories. Emphasizes methods of investigation in cognitive science as well as strategies for using a cognitive orientation in educational settings.

EDEP 6184.title: Socio-Contextual Influences on Learning and Instruction
EDEP 6184.description: Examines interplay between social, contextual, and environmental factors shaping educational experiences and outcomes. Explores contemporary theories such as situated learning, Constructivism, and ecological perspectives, and how these factors influence learning, motivation, instruction, and policy. Emphasis on the educator’s role in designing effective and meaningful learning spaces.

EDEP 6224.title: Constructivism and Education
EDEP 6224.description: Philosophical, theoretical, and empirical foundations of the broad field of constructivism, including the limits of epistemology and ontology, the determination of truth and reality, and applications to education and everyday life. Emphasis on radical constructivism, social constructivism, symbolic interactionism, social constructionism, and cognitive constructivism, and their applications to education.

EDEP 6444.title: Motivation and Cognition
EDEP 6444.description: Explores current research in the field of motivation as it relates to educational settings. Students will learn how motivation constructs relate to student behavior and cognition, how to select appropriate strategies to motivate students, and how to design measures to assess student motivation.

EDEP 6644.title: College Teaching
EDEP 6644.description: Teaching/planning process and consideration of teaching methods employed to encourage, guide, and evaluate college students learning.

EDEP 7964.title: Field Studies in Education
EDEP 7964.description: Advanced applied study in one or more educational institutions. Research, evaluation, curricular, and instructional projects are examples of appropriate projects of study. The student is graded on the basis of the design of the study, ability to conduct the study, and interpret and report the results.
